content: Part-of-speech tagging (POS) is the task of assigning a label (e.g., noun, verb, adjective) to each word in a given text. In this paper, we choose BERT as the backbone and conduct experiments on three Chinese POS datasets. We report the span-level micro-averaged precision, recall and F1 for evaluation. Hyperparameters are tuned on the corresponding development set of each dataset.
